notes.title: Patch 5.32 to be available on Tuesday, June 17th
notes.content:
The new patch 5.32 for Masters of the World will be available begining of next week.
Here is the patch content:
http://www.masters-of-the-world.com/maj.php

Additionnally, the MACOSX version of the game will be available on Steam within a week.
